hypotheses.justification: Split into n = 0 and 0 < n; the positive case uses the existing proof. For n = 0, VeroneseZero.lean proves of_zero_eq_algebraMap_mul_pow: every direct-sum generator is a degree-zero coefficient times a power of zeroVariable. By its definition and mem_component_iff, zeroVariable belongs to component 𝒮 0 1, hence to its algebraic adjoin. Closure under powers, multiplication and addition therefore puts every element in that adjoin. This proves the zero case without hgen, including when S is the trivial ring. Importing VeroneseZero supplies the cited identity.
